what_it_does: This paper designs a power rectifier circuit for harvesting energy from ambient radio frequency (RF) signals into microWatt-scale systems. RF energy harvesting is critical for batteryless IoT and sensor devices, but rectifiers typically lose significant power when input signals are weak and also waste power through reverse current leakage. The design uses a self-biased differential drive topology to minimize both forward and reverse losses across a wide range of input power levels.
